Joachim Wolf

Yet another new member Joachim Wolf from Sweden continued the entertainment by running to within a very few seconds of Richard's time and there, having staked their claims for team places in races to come, the C team ran out of men.
J.Wolf . . .

Eighteen year-old Frenchman Fabien Bernard-Gaudin, still without first team eligibility, led around the park and into the straight but Joachim Wolf had no intention of leaving things that way and closed him down to squeeze the A team ahead by inches at the takeover.
Our own Joachim Wolf led the Belgrave line-up and after a mile or so he was placing 4th with Rob leading the rest of the team in the early 20s.
Richard Hayman was not looking too comfortable but those "toughies" Rob McHarg, Will Cockerell and Joachim Wolf were running strongly with Norwegian Knut Hegvold also making an impression.
